summary: Harte Hanks filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, announcing the expiration of the go-shop period under its August 14, 2026 merger agreement with Star Equity Holdings. The company received acquisition proposals during the go-shop and delivered an Exempted Party designation notice to Star, while the board reaffirmed its recommendation of the Star merger. Consideration is Star 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a Form S-4 and proxy/prospectus to follow. Watch for a superior proposal and any revised Star terms; the all-stock preferred structure creates value and liquidity risk.
